messages:
maria: trying to onboard a user and hit a weird combo: poetry editable install + py.typed + async client = mypy and pip both explode :facepalm:

maria: steps: `poetry add --dev .` (using poetry 1.6.3), then pipx / local venv, trying to import redwood.client.aio and mypy cannot find typing stubs

maria: error snippet:
```
ERROR: redwood-client has no py.typed marker
note: import could not be resolved
```

maria: but package already has `py.typed` in repo root and `package_data` in pyproject. works if i `poetry build && pip install dist/redwood_client-*.whl` but fails on editable workflows (dev loop)

jonathan: ugh. i've seen this before with PEP 660/poetry editable support on mac/arm. what version of pip/setuptools?

maria: pip 24.1, setuptools 68.0, wheel 0.40. try on macbook m1 and ci linux runners (manylinux) — same symptom but different error lines sometimes (platform-tag mismatch on wheel creation)

sam: as a short workaround: `pip install -e .[dev]` in a plain venv (no poetry) preserves py.typed for mypy. poetry's editable backend historically didn't write py.typed into egg-info for some setups.

aaron: can you paste the relevant pyproject section? maybe packages not discovered so `py.typed` isn't included in installed package metadata

maria: sure:
```
[tool.poetry]
name = "redwood-client"
version = "0.8.0-dev"
packages = [{include = "redwood_client"}]
include = ["redwood_client/py.typed"]
```

maria: verified file exists at redwood_client/py.typed

katie: iirc poetry editable uses `pep517` backend and pip's new `editable` installer handles PEP 660 differently. poetry <1.6 had issues with include handling in editable. Upgrade poetry?

maria: upgraded to 1.6.3 already; still reproducible. created minimal repro and it's narrowed to combination of `async` package layout (submodule `aio`) + `py.typed` under package root. mypy complains about missing typings for `redwood_client.aio` only when installed editable via poetry

jonathan: could be package discovery: editable build backend may create a top-level `.pth` that points into source tree, mypy resolves differently. Also the import path `redwood.client.aio` vs `redwood_client.aio` — are imports normalized?

maria: our package import is `from redwood_client import aio as aio_client` in examples. Repo used hyphen vs underscore variants in README which confused one new hire earlier. but main issue remains even with corrected imports

aaron: two possible fixes: 1) ensure `py.typed` is declared in `package-data` under `tool.setuptools` or add a `MANIFEST.in` so editable installer picks it up; 2) file an issue against poetry's editable backend + link the repro so they can check.

maria: added a minimal `MANIFEST.in` locally and `include redwood_client/py.typed` — that fixed mypy in the editable case for me locally. will push a tiny packaging patch to include that as fallback

sam: also add a CI test that `pip install -e .` then `python -c "import redwood_client.aio; import importlib; print('ok')"` so we don't regress

maria: opened GH issue with repro and logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python/issues/312 (assigning to @devx) — added note about mac/arm and manylinux differences

ci-bot: automated test failure on `tests/integration/test_packaging.py::test_editable_pytyped` reported on linux/arm — see link: https://ci.redwood/internal/3456

katie: thanks. looks like we need an immediate hotfix (MANIFEST.in) and a follow-up to move to a setuptools-based fallback for editable until poetry fixes PEP660 parity in all setups

maria: yep. will send PR with MANIFEST + CI check + a docs blurb on recommended dev workflow (pipx vs poetry editable caveats). thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:
